name: Naples Soap Company Inc.
summary: Naples Soap Company Inc., a health and wellness enterprise, specializes in the development and distribution of a diverse range of personal care products, encompassing items for hair, face, skin, and traditional soaps. Headquartered in Fort Myers, Florida, this company was founded in 2009. Its market reach extends through various channels: 11 brick-and-mortar retail stores located across Florida, its dedicated e-commerce website naplessoap.com, other direct-to-consumer platforms like Amazon.com, and partnerships with approximately 300 boutiques, spas, and independent stores throughout the United States. Notably, the company previously operated as The GNS Group Inc. before rebranding as Naples Soap Company Inc. in May 2022.
